items.quote: Sn-Au-Bi alloys were prepared using pure Sn (99.99 wt%), pure Au (99.99 wt%), and pure Bi (99.9 wt%) in sealed transparent quartz capsules in argon atmosphere at 1100   C for about 2 h.
After heat treatment at 200   C, 250   C, 300   C, and 400   C from 7 days to 30 days, the alloys were quenched into the ice water and the annealed alloys were examined by EPMA (JXA-8800R, JEOL).
After that, the alloys were annealed at 200   C for 3 days for homogenization treatment.
The x-ray diffraction (XRD) was used to calibrate the EPMA results and identify the crystal structure of the Sn12Au49Bi39 alloy, which was annealed at 250   C for 1 month.

Some alloys annealed at 250   C for 30 days were used for differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) (NETZSCH, DSC-404C) examination, whose accuracy is about 1   C, to determine the transformation temperatures.
